correctness.rationale: By A³=A+I, B=A+A² over the integers and C=B+B² reduces to A² modulo two. Modulo two the irreducible cubic makes A multiplication by a generator of the seven nonzero elements of F_8. For each nonzero v, the three vectors v,Bv,Cv are independent since the field elements 1, α+α², α² are a basis. The first-coordinate row and its A-iterates exhaust the nonzero dual rows, so exactly one r gives (0,1,1). With H=A⁷, H²=I+4C and successive squaring imply H^(2^j)−I≡2^(j+1)C mod 2^(j+2) for j≥1; j=0 uses 2B. Since H acts trivially modulo two, adding 2^j to any index toggles the required bit without changing lower bits. Pairing the two halves of the index interval lifts the bijection from one modulus to the next, starting with the singleton modulo 2. Normalization and multiplication by 2^s give the remaining cases, with the zero triple immediate. The supplied finite checker was inspected, not run. An independent finite implementation independently_check.py checked all 28,672 primitive triples modulo 32 and all 32,767 nonzero triples there including normalized valuation strata; this corroborates the proof, not the infinite quantifier.

Fibonacci prime-field zero avoidance and valuations of particular shifted Padovan/Perrin sequences are not needed for the coverage finding.

evidence: A104217 records periods of the classical Perrin sequence, not arbitrary-seed subsequence counts. The classical-Perrin mirror ab2bd84778a5 gives exact even and odd sections for that particular seed. The odd-fibers mirror gives the all-seed branchwise formula in its proof.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The tabulated periods and the exact single-seed section alone do not cover the theorem's seed quantifier; the other indexed analytic result does.

originality.rationale: The indexed odd-fibers result is stronger than its headline full-period surjectivity: its Proof Steps 2–3 explicitly select the same (a_j,b_j,d_j)=(0,1,1) branch among all seven triples and prove the identical step-seven bijection to even residues for every primitive seed. Small moduli and scaling do not leave an independent claim. This is equivalent coverage by a distinct indexed record, not a determination of historical priority from directory dates.
residual_risks: Historical priority and identity of authors are not established by the distinct catalogue paths.

The general literature search gave no decisive arbitrary-seed passage. Klaška's cited Tribonacci full text was unavailable; the Bravo–Irmak comparison was limited to its abstract. These limits do not negate the verified branchwise match.

value.rationale: As a mathematical statement independently of coverage, the uniform parity selector and exact step-seven permutation give useful projected-orbit information for a natural recurrence. They resolve zero avoidance and give much more control than a state period or aggregate mean count, uniformly across seeds and precisions.
